tasks.title: Reach Vermilion while the Saffron gate is closed
tasks.goal: Reach Vermilion City. The Saffron guards have not been given a drink. Find a legal route. Trainers on this route are already defeated and wild encounters are disabled.
tasks.start: Route 5, just outside the northern entrance of the Saffron gate building.

tasks.title: Solve Victory Road 1F and climb to 2F
tasks.goal: Use the boulder puzzle to reach Victory Road 2F. Normal backtracking and room resets are allowed. Trainers on this route are already defeated and wild encounters are disabled.
tasks.start: Victory Road 1F, first controllable tile after entering from Route 23.

tasks.title: Traverse Mt. Moon and reach Cerulean City
tasks.goal: Travel through Mt. Moon and reach Cerulean City without blacking out. Trainers on this route are already defeated and wild encounters are disabled.
tasks.start: Mt. Moon 1F, first controllable tile inside the Route 3 entrance.

tasks.title: Cross Viridian Forest and reach Pewter City
tasks.goal: Reach Pewter City without blacking out. Trainers on this route are already defeated and wild encounters are disabled.
tasks.start: Viridian Forest, first controllable tile after entering through the southern gate.

tasks.title: Collect the Moon Stone in Rocket Hideout B2F
tasks.goal: Collect the Moon Stone on Rocket Hideout B2F. You may backtrack, but do not use a saved-state reset.
tasks.start: Rocket Hideout B2F, arrival tile from the B1F stairs at the northeast entrance.

tasks.title: Reach Sabrina's room through Saffron Gym
tasks.goal: Reach the tile directly south of Sabrina in Saffron Gym. Do not start her battle.
tasks.start: Saffron Gym, first controllable entrance tile from Saffron City.

tasks.title: Bruno Machamp resource tradeoff
tasks.goal: Defeat Elite Four member Bruno from the Machamp battle menu.
tasks.start: Bruno battle menu: Machamp level 58 is active.

tasks.title: Lorelei adaptation after a missed Hypnosis
tasks.goal: Defeat Elite Four member Lorelei after Poliwrath misses Hypnosis against Dewgong.
tasks.start: Lorelei battle menu: Dewgong level 54 is active after Poliwrath has missed Hypnosis.

tasks.title: Become Champion with Snorlax, Graveler, Charizard, Vileplume, Parasect, and Weezing
tasks.goal: From Indigo Plateau before Lorelei, defeat Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance, and the Champion, then complete Hall of Fame registration using the supplied party and bag. Do not nickname Pokemon.
tasks.start: Indigo Plateau overworld at the League entrance before Lorelei. All eight badges are owned, no Elite Four member or Champion has been defeated, and Hall of Fame entries are 0. The healthy full-PP party is Snorlax level 58, Graveler level 53, Charizard level 55, Vileplume level 31, Parasect level 30, and Weezing level 41. The bag contains Full Restore x5, Revive x5, Max Potion x1, and Elixer x1.

tasks.title: Become Champion with Pidgeot, Charizard, Lapras, Vileplume, Raticate, and Beedrill
tasks.goal: From Indigo Plateau before Lorelei, defeat Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance, and the Champion, then complete Hall of Fame registration using the supplied difficult team. Do not nickname Pokemon.
tasks.start: Indigo Plateau overworld at the League entrance before Lorelei. All eight badges are owned, no Elite Four member or Champion has been defeated, and Hall of Fame entries are 0. The healthy full-PP party is Pidgeot level 50, Charizard level 61, Lapras level 58, Vileplume level 44, Raticate level 33, and Beedrill level 38. The bag contains Revive x5, Elixer x1, and no HP-restoring Potions.

tasks.title: Agatha Gengar recovery
tasks.goal: Defeat Elite Four member Agatha from a damaged lead state.
tasks.start: Agatha battle menu: Gengar level 56 is active.

tasks.title: Brock with Squirtle and Pidgey
tasks.goal: Defeat Gym Leader Brock and earn the Boulder Badge with Squirtle level 15 and Pidgey level 12.
tasks.start: Pewter Gym battle menu: Brock leads Geodude level 12, then Onix level 14.

tasks.title: Champion preserve Jolteon
tasks.goal: Defeat Champion Blue while Jolteon remains unfainted.
tasks.start: Champion battle menu: Blue leads Pidgeot level 61.

tasks.title: Lorelei and Bruno PP gauntlet
tasks.goal: Defeat Lorelei and then Bruno without blacking out.
tasks.start: Lorelei battle menu: Dewgong level 54 is active. Bruno follows immediately after Lorelei.

tasks.title: Champion Blue starter-dependent lineup
tasks.goal: Defeat Champion Blue from a fixed authentic starter-dependent Champion lineup.
tasks.start: Champion battle menu: Blue leads Pidgeot level 61 from a fixed authentic starter-dependent party.

tasks.title: Lorelei tactical v2 Poliwrath team
tasks.goal: Defeat Elite Four member Lorelei using tactical team version 2.
tasks.start: Lorelei battle menu: Dewgong level 54 is active.

tasks.title: Lorelei recovery with registered bad-matchup team
tasks.goal: Defeat Elite Four member Lorelei without any supplied Pokémon fainting.
tasks.start: Lorelei battle menu: Dewgong level 54 is active against Graveler level 45.

tasks.title: Route 1 Rattata battle
tasks.goal: Defeat the wild level 3 Rattata on Route 1 without fleeing or catching it.
tasks.start: Battle menu: wild Route 1 Rattata level 3 at full HP.

tasks.title: Free a bag slot and exchange the Bike Voucher
tasks.goal: Exchange your Bike Voucher for a Bicycle. Your bag is full. Keep the voucher until the exchange and make room by any legal method.
tasks.start: Cerulean Bike Shop, in front of the clerk with a Bike Voucher and all 20 bag slots occupied.

tasks.title: Switch from Charmander to party slot 3 Pikachu
tasks.goal: At the trainer battle command menu, choose PKMN and switch from Charmander to Pikachu in party slot 3. Do not select FIGHT, ITEM, or RUN.
tasks.start: Viridian Forest at the live second Bug Catcher trainer battle command menu. The opponent has native Weedle level 7, Kakuna level 7, and Weedle level 7. Party slot 1 Charmander is active at 30/39 HP and healthy, slot 2 Pidgey is 23/23 HP and healthy, and slot 3 Pikachu is 35/35 HP and healthy. No player command has been selected.

tasks.title: Buy exactly ten Poke Balls at Viridian Poke Mart
tasks.goal: Enter the Viridian Poke Mart and buy exactly 10 Poke Balls. Spend all 2000 Pokedollars and buy nothing else. Finish outside the Mart in Viridian City.
tasks.start: Viridian City overworld one tile south of the Poke Mart entrance. The bag contains Poke Ball x0, Potion x1, and Antidote x1. Cash is exactly 2000 Pokedollars. Party slot 1 Bulbasaur is 29/29 HP and healthy.

tasks.title: Use one Antidote on party slot 3 Nidoran♂
tasks.goal: Open the Bag and use exactly one Antidote on the poisoned Nidoran♂ in party slot 3. Do not use any other item. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Viridian City overworld outside the Pokemon Center. Party slot 1 Bulbasaur is 29/29 HP and healthy, slot 2 Pidgey is 23/23 HP and healthy, and slot 3 Nidoran♂ is 18/28 HP and poisoned. The bag contains Antidote x1, Potion x2, and Poke Ball x4.

tasks.title: Deposit and withdraw party slot 2 Pikachu
tasks.goal: At the Viridian Pokemon Center PC, deposit Pikachu from party slot 2 into the active box, withdraw that same Pikachu after it appends to party slot 3, then use the party menu SWITCH command to restore the order Bulbasaur, Pikachu, Pidgey. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Viridian Pokemon Center overworld at the PC. Party order is Bulbasaur 29/29 healthy, Pikachu 35/35 healthy, Pidgey 23/23 healthy. The active Pokemon Storage System box contains Rattata 18/18 healthy and has 19 free slots. The bag contains Potion x1.

tasks.title: Use one Potion on party slot 2 Pikachu
tasks.goal: Open the Bag and use exactly one Potion on Pikachu in party slot 2. Do not use any other item or change the party order. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Route 1 overworld at the north grass edge. Party slot 1 Bulbasaur is 29/29 HP and healthy, slot 2 Pikachu is 12/35 HP and healthy, and slot 3 Pidgey is 23/23 HP and healthy. The bag contains Potion x1, Antidote x1, and Poke Ball x3.

tasks.title: Complete an inventory and party checklist
tasks.goal: At the Viridian Pokemon Center, withdraw one Potion from the item PC, use it on Pikachu in party slot 2, then reorder the party to Pidgey, Bulbasaur, Pikachu. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Viridian Pokemon Center overworld at the PC. Party order is Bulbasaur 29/29 healthy, Pikachu 10/35 healthy, Pidgey 23/23 healthy. The item PC contains Potion x1 and Antidote x1. The bag contains Potion x0, Antidote x1, and Poke Ball x3.

tasks.title: Move party slot 3 Pidgey to the lead
tasks.goal: Use the party menu’s SWITCH command as many times as necessary to change the party order from Bulbasaur, Pikachu, Pidgey to Pidgey, Bulbasaur, Pikachu. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Pewter City overworld outside the Pokemon Center. Party order is slot 1 Bulbasaur 29/29 HP healthy, slot 2 Pikachu 35/35 HP healthy, slot 3 Pidgey 23/23 HP healthy. The bag contains Potion x1 and Poke Ball x3.

tasks.title: Use one Ether on Squirtle Water Gun
tasks.goal: Open the Bag, use exactly one Ether on Squirtle in party slot 1, then select Water Gun. Do not restore Bubble PP. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Route 24 overworld. Party slot 1 Squirtle level 15 is at full HP and healthy with Tackle 35/35 PP, Tail Whip 30/30 PP, Bubble 8/30 PP, and Water Gun 5/25 PP. Party slot 2 Pidgey is at full HP and healthy. The bag contains Ether x1, Potion x1, and Poke Ball x5.

tasks.title: Teach TM34 Bide to Pikachu over Growl
tasks.goal: Use TM34 to teach Bide to Pikachu in party slot 2. When prompted, replace Growl in move slot 2. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Celadon City overworld. Party slot 1 Bulbasaur is 29/29 HP healthy, slot 2 Pikachu is 35/35 HP healthy with ThunderShock, Growl, Tail Whip, and Thunder Wave at full PP, and slot 3 Pidgey is 23/23 HP healthy. The bag contains TM34 x1, Potion x1, and Poke Ball x3.

tasks.title: Withdraw one Potion and use it on Pikachu
tasks.goal: At the Viridian Pokemon Center item PC, withdraw one Potion, then use it from the Bag on Pikachu in party slot 2. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.
tasks.start: Viridian Pokemon Center overworld at the PC. Party slot 1 Bulbasaur is 29/29 HP healthy, slot 2 Pikachu is 10/35 HP healthy, and slot 3 Pidgey is 23/23 HP healthy. The item PC contains Potion x1 and Antidote x1. The bag contains Potion x0, Antidote x1, and Poke Ball x3.

tasks.title: Lorelei roster assembly from storage
tasks.goal: Assemble a party for Lorelei from the stated active party and PC box.
tasks.start: Target fight: Lorelei, Dewgong level 54, Cloyster level 53, Slowbro level 54, Jynx level 56, Lapras level 56.

tasks.title: Lance damaged team rescue
tasks.goal: Allocate scarce recovery supplies before Lance.
tasks.start: Target fight: Lance, Gyarados level 58, Dragonair level 56, Dragonair level 56, Aerodactyl level 60, Dragonite level 62.

tasks.title: Brock lead selection with Squirtle and Pidgey
tasks.goal: Choose the lead for the Brock battle.
tasks.start: Target fight: Brock, Geodude level 12 then Onix level 14.

tasks.title: Kadabra TM choice for Lorelei then Bruno
tasks.goal: Choose one Kadabra move replacement for consecutive Lorelei and Bruno fights.
tasks.start: Target fights: Lorelei followed by Bruno.

tasks.title: Lorelei and Bruno Elixer allocation
tasks.goal: Allocate one Elixer before the Lorelei to Bruno gauntlet.
tasks.start: Target fights: Lorelei followed by Bruno.

tasks.title: Brock Pokémon Center recovery
tasks.goal: Use the free Pokémon Center recovery before fighting Brock.
tasks.start: Pewter City before Brock with a damaged party and the Pokémon Center available.

tasks.title: Elite Four resource preparation
tasks.goal: Prepare fixed resources for Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance, and Champion Blue.
tasks.start: Target sequence: Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance, then Champion Blue.

tasks.title: TM24 Thunderbolt allocation for Lorelei
tasks.goal: Choose a legal recipient for the only Thunderbolt TM.
tasks.start: Target fight: Lorelei, Dewgong level 54, Cloyster level 53, Slowbro level 54, Jynx level 56, Lapras level 56.

tasks.title: Misty shopping with Pikachu and Bulbasaur
tasks.goal: Buy supplies for the Misty battle within the listed cash and stock.
tasks.start: Target fight: Misty, Staryu level 18 then Starmie level 21.

tasks.title: Champion Blue lineup preparation
tasks.goal: Prepare for any of the three disclosed Champion Blue rosters before the variant is selected.
tasks.start: Target fight: Champion Blue from one of three equally weighted native starter-dependent parties.

tasks.title: Catch Abra on Route 24, train it, then defeat Misty
tasks.goal: From Cerulean City, catch a wild Abra on Route 24, raise it by at least one level without releasing it, then defeat Misty in Cerulean Gym for the Cascade Badge. Keep default Pokemon names.
tasks.start: Cerulean City overworld at the Route 24 entrance. Red has the Boulder Badge but not the Cascade Badge. The Nugget Bridge rival is already defeated, so Routes 24 and 25 are accessible. Party slot 1 Ivysaur level 20 has Tackle, Growl, Leech Seed, and Vine Whip at full PP, slot 2 Pidgeotto level 18 has Gust, Sand-Attack, and Quick Attack at full PP, slot 3 Pikachu level 18 has ThunderShock, Growl, Tail Whip, and Quick Attack at full PP, and slots 4 through 6 are empty. The bag contains Poke Ball x8, Potion x2, Antidote x1, and 2400 Pokedollars. No Abra is owned and Misty is unbeaten.

tasks.title: Catch level 30 Snorlax with 12 Great Balls
tasks.goal: Catch this Snorlax using your supplied team and 12 Great Balls. You may lower its HP or apply status. Do not flee, knock it out or black out. Keep its default name.
tasks.start: The healthy-capture checkpoint at the opening command menu against the natural level 30 Snorlax, initially at full HP with no status.

tasks.title: Find and catch a wild Pikachu from Viridian City
tasks.goal: Catch a wild Pikachu and keep it in your party. You start in Viridian City with 10 Poke Balls. Do not buy more balls or use stored Pokemon. Keep default names. Free balls found on the ground are allowed.
tasks.start: Viridian Pokemon Center, first controllable tile after a full party heal.

tasks.title: Obtain a Bicycle through the Fan Club quest
tasks.goal: Obtain a Bicycle. You have 3000 money, no Bike Voucher and cannot afford the displayed purchase price. Find another legal way to obtain one.
tasks.start: Cerulean Bike Shop, in front of the clerk before opening a conversation.

tasks.title: Help Bill and receive the S.S. Ticket
tasks.goal: Speak to Bill, help him with his problem and collect his reward. Follow what he tells you.
tasks.start: Bill's house on Route 25, entrance tile before speaking to transformed Bill.

tasks.title: Collect Oak's Parcel in Viridian and return it
tasks.goal: Collect Oak's Parcel from Viridian Mart and deliver it to Professor Oak to receive the Pokedex. Keep default Pokemon names.
tasks.start: Pallet Town, immediately outside Oak's Lab after the first rival battle and free recovery.

tasks.title: Rescue Mr. Fuji and obtain the Poke Flute
tasks.goal: Rescue Mr. Fuji and obtain the Poke Flute. Do not use the Poke Doll ghost bypass.
tasks.start: Lavender Town, directly outside the Pokemon Tower entrance.

tasks.title: Clear Rocket Hideout and defeat Giovanni for the Silph Scope
tasks.goal: From Celadon City, enter the Rocket Hideout beneath the Game Corner, obtain the Lift Key, defeat Giovanni on B4F, and pick up the Silph Scope. Keep default Pokemon names.
tasks.start: Celadon City overworld outside the Game Corner. Red has Boulder, Cascade, and Thunder Badges, Charmeleon level 31 with Ember, Leer, Rage, and Scratch at full PP, Kadabra level 29 with Teleport, Confusion, Disable, and Psybeam at full PP, Gyarados level 28 with Tackle, Bite, Leer, and Dragon Rage at full PP, Super Potion x4, Antidote x2, Escape Rope x1, and 6200 Pokedollars. The Rocket Hideout is unopened, the Lift Key is absent, Giovanni on Rocket Hideout B4F is unbeaten, and the Silph Scope is absent.

tasks.title: Choose any starter in Oak's Lab
tasks.goal: Choose Bulbasaur, Charmander or Squirtle and complete the starter handover. Keep its default name.
tasks.start: Oak's Lab, immediately after Oak's opening escort and explanation, before any starter ball has been selected.

pricing.basis: Standard API-equivalent USD at this dated rate card. Not subscription charges.
pricing.range: Recorded cache reads are discounted. Unknown cache writes span no write to all uncached input for OpenAI, and 5-minute to 1-hour writes for Claude. Missing cache breakdown spans compatible input prices. These are pricing scenarios, not statistical confidence intervals.
